question.prompt: The profit per item is 3 yuan, and the fixed costs have already been recovered. The number of items sold, \(x\), must satisfy \(3x>21\) for the profit to exceed 21 yuan. What is the smallest positive integer value of \(x\)?

solutions.explanation: \(3x>21\) gives \(x>7\). The smallest positive integer is 8.
solutions.title: Solve the supplied inequality and select the least integer
